'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**Five [[Cameroon]]ian soldiers are killed in an attack by [[Ambazonia]]n separatists in [[Kouoptamo ]]district. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/five-military-police-killed-western-cameroon-says-regional-governor-2022-06-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Turkish occupation of northern Syria]]
**The [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] (SDF) threatens to turn to [[President of Syria|Syrian President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] for support if [[Turkey]] launches a new [[military operation]] in northern [[Syria]], where the SDF controls [[Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria|most of its territory]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/7/sdf-turn-assad-turkey-attacks-syria (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Censorship in the United Kingdom]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] cinema chain [[Cineworld]] cancels all showings of the [[historical drama]] ''[[The Lady of Heaven]]'', following days of protests by [[Islam in the United Kingdom|Muslims]] who say that the movie is [[Islam and blasphemy|blasphemous]] and [[sectarianism|sectarian]]. Cineworld says that the decision to cancel showings was to "ensure the safety of our staff and customers". [https://www.theguardian.com/film/2022/jun/07/uk-cinema-chain-cancels-screenings-of-film-the-lady-of-heaven-after-protests (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**The [[United States]] [[US Department of the Treasury|Department of the Treasury]] bans all trading of [[Russia]]n debt and stocks, including on the secondary market. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/us-treasury-says-all-buying-russian-debt-equity-banned-under-sanctions-2022-06-07/ (Reuters)]
**Russia freezes Western banks' and investment funds' assets worth $17 billion. [https://www.rp.pl/biznes/art36469231-rosja-zamraza-aktywa-zagranicznych-firm-i-bankow (''Rzeczpospolita'')] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Killa Saifullah bus crash]]
**Twenty-two people are killed when a bus falls into a ravine in [[Killa Saifullah District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-accidents-7a1814606d4e01aaa3b91f0cc130dc99 (AP)]
*[[Kasai diamond mine collapse]]
**Six people are killed after a diamond mine collapsed in [[Kasaï-Oriental|Kasai]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/six-people-killed-congo-diamond-mine-cave-in-2022-06-09/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are killed and several others are injured when a [[train collides]] with a truck in [[Gara Oreshets]], [[Bulgaria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bulgaria-sofia-accidents-business-0b72787177bd7b00db0fe64ac89502ee (AP)]

*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****[[Prime Minister of Andorra|Prime Minister]] [[Xavier Espot]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2022/06/07/espot_dona_positiu_per_covid_201878_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]

****[[Minister for Foreign Affairs (Germany)|Minister of Foreign Affairs]] [[Annalena Baerbock]] tests positive for COVID-19. *[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Timeline of the 2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
***[[Bangladesh]] and [[The Bahamas]] report their first suspected cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://bangla.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2022/06/07/16545967832381 (''Dhaka Tribune'')] [https://caribbean.loopnews.com/content/bahamas-investigates-suspected-monkeypox-case (Caribbean Loop News)]
*[[2022 Mariupol cholera outbreak]]
**[[Mariupol]] reports its first confirmed cases of [[cholera]] as well as its first confirmed deaths from cholera. [https://ukranews.com/en/news/861229-epidemic-begins-in-mariupol-first-cases-of-cholera-and-dysentery-recorded (Ukra News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Japan–Russia relations]], [[Kuril Islands dispute]]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Ministry]] spokeswoman [[Maria Zakharova]] announces that [[Russia]] will cancel a 1998 agreement with [[Japan]] allowing Japanese fishermen to operate near the southern [[Kuril Islands]], claiming that Japan is not meeting the financial obligations outlined in the agreement. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/7/russia-suspends-deal-with-japan-on-fishing-near-disputed-islands (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Cambodia–China relations]]
**[[Cambodia]] and [[China]] break ground on a joint expansion project of the [[Ream Naval Base]] near [[Sihanoukville (city)|Sihanoukville]], [[Cambodia]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jun/07/chinese-military-to-have-exclusive-use-of-parts-of-cambodian-naval-base-ream-gulf-of-thailand (''The Guardian'')]
*An independent inquiry established by the [[United Nations Human Rights Council|U.N. Human Rights Council]] following the [[2021 Israel–Palestine crisis]] issues a report accusing [[Israel]] of seeking "complete control" over the [[Palestinian territories]], and of granting "different civil status, rights and legal protection" to [[Arab citizens of Israel|the country's Arab citizens]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/7/un-report-finds-israeli-occupation-root-cause-of-conflict (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-mandated-rights-inquiry-rebukes-israel-seeking-complete-control-2022-06-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Allison Fluke-Ekren pleads guilty in a federal court in [[Alexandria, Virginia]], United States, of providing material support to [[Islamic State|ISIS]] by conspiring to conduct terrorist attacks on [[United States]] soil and by leading and training at least 100 female ISIS fighters. Fluke-Ekren also claimed in her plea deal to helping [[Ansar al-Sharia (Libya)|Ansar al-Sharia]] analyze documents stolen during the [[2012 Benghazi attack]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/07/politics/isis-allison-fluke-ekren-plea/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Human rights in Russia]]
**Russia's [[State Duma]] votes nearly unanimously to pass a bill ending the jurisdiction of the [[European Court of Human Rights]] in the country, with only one lawmaker from the [[Communist Party of the Russian Federation|Communist Party]] opposing the bill. The bill must now be signed by President [[Vladimir Putin]] before becoming law. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-parliament-votes-exit-european-court-human-rights-2022-06-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[List of Princes and Grand Masters of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta|Lieutenant of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta]] [[Marco Luzzago]] dies and is succeeded ''ad interim'' by [[Ruy Gonçalo do Valle Peixoto de Villas Boas]]. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2022/06/07/order-of-maltas-lieutenant-dies_7204e616-481a-4cb9-bc0c-2daa977b78b3.html (ANSA)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[European Commission]] agrees to make [[USB Type-C]] the common charging port for all [[mobile phone]]s, tablets and cameras in the [[European Union]] by autumn 2024. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/eu-countries-lawmakers-clinch-deal-single-mobile-charging-port-2022-06-07/ (Reuters)]
